news_cards.title: Cabinet Approves GOBARdhan Scheme for Compressed Biogas
bullets: Kendra sarkar ne GOBARdhan yojana ko mana, jiska udeshya compressed biogas ka utpaadan hai
Is yojana ke liye 23,731 crore rupee ka outlay hai
Yeh yojana kisanon aur pashupalakon ke liye labhdayak hogi

news_cards.title: Agni-4 Ballistic Missile ka Safal Pareekshan
bullets: Bharat ne Agni-4 ballistic missile ka safal pareekshan kiya hai
Is missile ki maark kshamta 4000 kilometer hai
Yeh pareekshan Odisha ke Chandipur mein kiya gaya tha

news_cards.title: RBI ne NBFC ki Upper Layer ki List Jari Ki
bullets: RBI ne NBFC ki upper layer ki list jari ki hai
Is list mein 17 NBFCs shamil hain
Yeh list NBFCs ke financial performance ke aadhar par taiyar ki gayi hai

news_cards.title: BRICS Summit ka Aayojan Jaipur mein
bullets: BRICS summit ka aayojan Jaipur mein kiya ja raha hai
Is summit mein BRICS deshon ke udhyog mantri bhag lenge
Yeh summit MSME aur startup ko badhava dene par kendrit hai

news_cards.title: Ranipur Tiger Reserve mein Tendua ka Rescue
bullets: Ranipur Tiger Reserve mein ek tendua ka rescue kiya gaya hai
Yeh tendua dudhwa national park se rescue kiya gaya tha
Ranipur Tiger Reserve mein yeh tendua chhoda gaya hai

news_cards.title: National Handloom Day ka Aayojan
bullets: National Handloom Day ka aayojan kiya gaya hai
Is din ko manane ke liye kai karyakram aayojit kiye gaye hain
Yeh din handloom industry ko badhava dene ke liye manaya jata hai

news_cards.title: India Japan Annual Summit ka Aayojan
bullets: India Japan Annual Summit ka aayojan kiya ja raha hai
Is summit mein donon deshon ke beech sambandh badhane par charcha hogi
Yeh summit India aur Japan ke beech economic sambandh ko badhane mein madad karega
